products.description:
XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol – Futuristic Power & Precision

The XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper-Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol delivers a bold, futuristic design combined with a highly practical feeding system that sets it apart from traditional gel blaster pistols. Built for fast-paced backyard play and casual skirmishing, the ZP2 blends eye-catching sci-fi styling with simple, dependable operation.

At the heart of the ZP2 is its top-mounted hopper feed system, allowing multiple gel balls to be loaded at once and fed directly into the firing mechanism. This eliminates the need for standard stick magazines, reduces reload interruptions, and keeps the pistol lightweight and easy to handle. The result is a smooth, user-friendly gel blaster that’s ideal for beginners, younger players, or anyone looking for something a little different from conventional pistol designs. Note: Top mount hopper can feed a little irregularly, as gravity is the only force feeding the gels. If you get misfires, with no gel balls being fired, turn the unit upside down and shake gently to ensure that two gels aren’t caught next to each other in the loading neck.

The ZP2’s compact frame and ergonomic grip make it comfortable to use for extended sessions, while its clean Green Camo finish enhances the futuristic aesthetic. Whether you’re plinking targets in the backyard, introducing new players to gel blasting, or adding a unique sidearm to your collection, the XYL ZP2 offers a fun, accessible, and visually distinctive experience. Another super cool feature is the included tactical torch, which can be mounted into the front of the blaster. Simply remove the dome-shaped blanking cap, and push the torch in. Once in place, push the end of the torch to turn it on, then push it again to turn it off (1 x AA battery required, not included)

XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol Features:

  • Futuristic sci-fi–inspired gel blaster pistol design
  • Hopper-fed system for quick loading and reduced reload downtime
  • Lightweight and compact for easy handling
  • Digital Shot counter, on the rear of the gun.
  • Firing modes: Safe, Semi and Full Auto (Controlled by the orange switch on the base of the handle)
  • Simple operation, ideal for beginners and casual players
  • No traditional magazine required
  • Durable polymer construction
  • Striking Green Camo finish with modern styling

XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol Specifications:

  • Brand: XYL
  • Model: ZP2
  • Operation: Hopper-fed gel blaster pistol
  • Construction: Polymer body
  • Feed System: Gravity Fed Top-mounted hopper
  • Colour: Green Camo
  • Ammo Type: Standard gel balls
  • Power Source: Battery powered (internal)
  • Use Case: Backyard play, entry-level gel blasting, recreational shooting

What’s in the box: 

  • 1x XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster
  • 1 x Pinapple Hopper Bottle
  • 1 x Hopper picatinny mounting Collar
  • 1 x Tactical LED Torch (1 x AA battery required, not included)
  • 1 x USB Charging Cable
  • 1 x 7.4v LiPo rechargeable batter (Already pre-installed)
  • 1 x Instruction Manual, + instruction diagrams on the inside of the box lid.
  • Sample Gels

All stock held in our QLD warehouse and we post Australia wide.

Ages Guide: Not suitable for persons under 14 years of age.

Pics are for illustration purpose only.

 

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

Additional information

Weight 1.65 kg
Dimensions 37.5 × 22 × 8 cm
Brands XYL

products.name: Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet
products.short_description: Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet is a premium gel blaster gear listing with clearer tactical detail, fast Australia-wide dispatch and a more confident buying path. Secure current stock while availability remains live.
products.description:
Perun V2 Hybrid replaces mechanical contacts in your airsoft replica or gel blaster and provides lots of useful features. Optical and magnetic sensors allow to eliminate many moving parts that are prone to damage, thus increasing the reliability. Adaptive trigger control allows switching from a very short trigger travel to a long one even in the field, with almost any trigger, including stock ones.
Works without the need for any modification with most V2 gearboxes in Tokyo Marui standard. For details and exceptions please refer to the manual.

Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet Features;

  • Adjustable trigger sensitivityÂ â€“ The trigger can be set to 5 sensitivity levels, ranging from very short pull needed to fire a shot, to a very long one. No modification to the trigger or the gearbox is needed and the trigger sensitivity change is possible even in the field.
  • Independently programmed firing modesÂ â€“ Program the firing modes any way you like, setting safe, semi, burst or auto on both selector positions.
  • Active brakeÂ â€“ active brake stops the motor after each shot preventing spring compression or in case of replicas with high rate of fire, over spin (double shot problem).
  • Pre-cockingÂ â€“ Fast trigger response can be a matter of victory or defeat, especially in CQB situations. With pre-cocking enabled, piston will remain in rear position after each shot with the spring already compressed, ensuring that next shot will be fired immediately after you pull the trigger. To release the spring after using pre-cocking, pull the trigger and hold it for 2 seconds, after which a second shot will be fired, this time with no pre-cocking and fully braked.
  • 2-stage triggerÂ â€“ Light trigger pull results with a single shot or burst, while a deeper pull will cause a burst or fully automatic fire. Following modes are available: semi â€“ burst, semi â€“ auto and burst â€“ auto.
  • Binary triggerÂ â€“ Allows for easy double shots in semi-automatic setting. After enabling this mode, if semi-automatic fire is set, shots will be fired not only when the trigger is pulled, but also when it is released.
  • Rate of fire reductionÂ â€“ Reduce the rate of fire in automatic or burst fire to save ammo or make the replica shoot in a more realistic fashion.
  • DMR modeÂ â€“ Introduces intervals between semiautomatic shots to comply with DMR rules on some fields.
  • Low battery voltage alarmÂ â€“ Dedicated for Li-Po and Li-Ion batteries. Should the battery voltage fall to a dangerously low level, user will be notified by short sound signals that are repeated every minute. This may also be freely switched on and off.
  • DSGÂ â€“ a sector gear detection mode specially prepared to work with dual sector gears.
  • Diagnostic systemÂ â€“ Constantly monitors the replica and the mosfet itself. In case of any problems, immediately lets you know what it might be, making troubleshooting much easier.
  • Electronic fuseÂ â€“ Will save your replica and battery in case of a major malfunction. It will automatically disconnect the battery when a short circuit or blocked motor is detected.

Programming of all the settings is done solely by using quick and easily memorable sequences of fire selector switching and trigger pulls supported by sound signals and multicolour LED diode. That allows changing the settings in any moment, in a matter of seconds, even under enemy fire. All settings are set independently for each selector position, so you can program the mosfet exactly the way you want, for example semi on semi and binary trigger on auto.
Perun V2 Hybrid works without problems with any battery from 7V do 17V. It can also be used with most extreme setups.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

FIRE MODES:

– Semi: it fires single shot per trigger pull.
– Semi/Burst X: short trigger pull fires single shot, long trigger pull fires burst.
– Binary trigger: it fires single shot when trigger is pulled and another single shot when is released.

– Virtual reload: pull trigger to reload virtual magazine

EXTERNAL INPUT:

–Â AUG trigger: selector plate detection is disabled. Trigger is set to selector on semi. Micro switch connected to Input (SIG, GND) is set to selector on auto.

–Â Empty mag (NC): Micro switch activates empty magazine detection, when is disconnected SIG with GND.
–Â Virtual reload: Micro switch activates virtual magazine reload, when is connected SIG with GND.

EXTERNAL OUTPUT:
Works with Output terminal:

New functions are for freeÂ for every user via online update

Â Â Â Â Â Â Â

USE WITH BRUSHLESS MOTOR:
– Leviathan can be used with brushless motor (Warhead, Option No. 1, etc.)
– The following functions in the Leviathan must be set to:

  • Active brake = Off
  • Rate of fire = 100%

PACKING:

products.description:
This laser sight has integrated optics and electronics providing a wide field of view. They are very suitable for fast aiming and shooting at stationary and moving targets.

Operation

Fix the laser sight onto your gel blaster rifle or pistol

Make elevation adjustments by turning the 2 small grub screws in the body of the sight with the smaller allen key, turning it until the laser is aligned to your preference.

To install and change the batteries, unscrew and open the back cover of the body, then install the batteries (3 x LR44 button cell). Finally, replace the back cover.

To operate the laser, press the switch.

Safety Precautions

Never look directly into the laser beam.

Never point a laser beam at a person.

Do not aim the laser at reflective surfaces.

Never view a laser pointer using an optical instrument, such as binocular or a microscope.

Do not allow children to use laser pointers unless under the supervision of an adult.

Package Includes

1 x laser sight scope

1 x Allen key wrench

3 x button batteries

products.description:
IMAX B6AC is the ultimate RC hobby intelligent multifunction charger which can charge and discharge for Li-ion /Polymer batteries, Ni-MH/Cd batteries, even Pb batteries. It’s all-powerful at an extremely well known model to enthusiasts in the RC and model hobby industry. In comparison with similar products currently available in the market, the IMAX B6AC has special features as follows:

Optimized Operating Software

B6AC features an AUTO function that sets the feed current during the process of charging or discharging. Especially for Lithium batteries, it can prevent the overcharging which may lead to an explosion. It can disconnect form the circuit automatically and sound an alarm if any malfunction is detected. All the programs of this product are controlled through two way linkage and communication buttons to achieve maximum safety and minimise setting confusion.

Balancing Individual Cells While Battery Discharging

During the process of discharging, the B6AC can monitor and balance each cell of the battery individually. An Error message will be displayed and the process will be ended automatically if the voltage of any single one cell is abnormal.

Adaptable to Various Types of Lithium Battery

The B6AC is adaptable to various types of Lithium batteries, such as Li-ion, LiPo and the new LiFe series of batteries.

Fast and Storage Mode Charging of Lithium Batteries

These functions allow Lithium batteries to be fast charged to greatly reduce total duration of charging time, whereas store state can control the final voltage of your battery to allow safe storage over long periods of time.

Maximum Safety

Delta-peak sensitivity: Automatic charge termination program based on the principle of Delta-peak voltage detection. When the battery’s voltage exceeds the threshold, the process will be terminated automatically.

Automatic Charging Current Limit

You can set up the upper limit of the charging current when charging your NiCd or NiMH battery which useful when charging a NiMH battery of low impedance and capacity in the ‘AUTO’ charging mode.

Capacity limit

The charging capacity is calculated as the charging current multiplied by time. If the charging capacity exceeds the limit, the process will be terminated automatically when you set the maximum value.

Temperature threshold*

The battery’s internal chemical reaction will cause the temperature of the battery to rise. If the temperature limit is reached, the process will be terminated. * This function is available by connecting optional temperature probe, which is not included in our package.

Processing Time Limit

You can also limit the maximum process time to avoid any possible possible problems.

Input Power Monitoring

If using a car battery as a DC input power source the B6AC constantly monitors the battery for low voltage. If the voltage drops below the lower limit, the process will be ended automatically.

Data Store/Load

A maximum of five batteries data can be stored for user convenience. You can store the data pertaining each batteries’ program setting of their continuous charging or discharging. Users can recall this data at any time without any special program setting.

Cyclic Charging/Discharging

1 to 5 cyclic and continuous process of charge/discharge or discharge/charge is selectable for battery refreshing and Balancing to help optimise the performance of your battery.

  • DC input: 11-18Volt

  • Circuit power: Max.charge power 50W

  • Charge current range: 0.1-6.0A
  • Discharge current range: 0.1-2.0A
  • Current drain for balancing Li-po: 200mA/cell
  • NiCd/NiMH battery cell count: 1-15cells
  • Li-ion/Polymer cell count: 1-6cells
  • Pb battery voltage: 2-20V
  • Net weight: 575g
  • Dimension: 135x144x36mm

products.description:
Originally developed during the late stages of the Vietnam War era, the real HEL E4A was one of the early military-issued rifle suppressors.

It was designed to reduce muzzle flash and report on 5.56Ã—45 mm rifles, allowing special units to operate with improved stealth in dense jungle and night-time operations.

Â Historic Background:

  • The HEL E4A suppressor was field-tested by elements of the U.S. Army Special Forces (Green Berets), MACV-SOG teams, and some SEAL detachments during the Vietnam conflict.
  • It was primarily paired with early-pattern M16 and CAR-15/XM177-type rifles, as well as occasionally with starlight-scope-equipped marksman rifles for ambush and reconnaissance missions.
  • Although later replaced by more modern designs such as the XM-style and OPS/SSS suppressors, the E4A represents one of the pioneering steps in practical military rifle suppression.

products.description:
Bite Sized Fusion Engine

Winner of the “Best HPA Engine” in the 9th Airsoft Players Choice Awards, the dual solenoid design of the F2â„¢ provides the same functionality as the legendary Fusion Engineâ„¢ but in a more compact, efficient and flexible design. Dual solenoids allow for the nozzle and the poppet valve to be adjusted independently of each other for unparalleled control over both the loading time and air volume used. Additionally, this makes it possible to change the firing sequence giving it the ability to operate in both true closed bolt as well as “AEG” mode.

The F2â„¢ incorporates a new one-piece, lightweight poppet valve design yet still operates on the same principle as the Fusion Engineâ„¢ poppet. This valve is able to operate at lower pressures and uses less air volume to function which optimizes air efficiency.

A robust design allows for an operating pressure range of 45psi to 145psi which enables the F2â„¢ to achieve velocities from CQB to DMR while employing only one nozzle for the entire velocity adjustment range.

Additionally, its nozzle is spring biased forward which provides a consistent loading force regardless of operating pressure. It shares the same spring as the Fusion Engineâ„¢ with both light and heavy spring options available to adjust the loading force.

Gel Blaster Compatible

ï»¿F2Â HPA conversion kits can also be configured for use in gel blasters.

Please contact us for information on ordering F2 systems for gel blaster use.

Â Velocity: 480fps w/ .20g @ 145psi
The F2â„¢ allows for easy velocity adjustment just by changing input pressure and does not require different nozzles to reach its full velocity range. Using a standard M4 as an example, velocity can be adjusted from below 280fps and up to approximately 480fps with a .20g BB. Velocity can vary per model as longer barrels will increase the maximum velocity while shorter barrels will decrease it.Â 
ROF: 30rps
The maximum cyclic rate of the F2â„¢ is affected by several factors such as the operating pressure as well as quality of the magazine and BB’s used. However, 30 rounds per second is achievable in most standard configurations.
Air Efficiency: 1000+ shots from 13/3000 @ 1.5JÂ  w/ .28g
The standard F2â„¢ poppet valve is equivalent to the Red Low-Flow poppet of the Fusion Engineâ„¢. However, this valve responds faster and requires less air volume to operate so the F2â„¢ is able to achieve greater air efficiency than even a finely tuned Fusion Engineâ„¢.
(Test Configuration: Red Poppet / 6.05x375mm Barrel)

Â 

**All kits come with an FCU, Switchboard, Wire Harness and any additional components needed to convert the specific airsoft rifle model for which the kit is configured. The HPA Tank, Air Rig (regulator/line/QD fitting) and Battery needed to operate the system are purchased separately.

This Classic Army Gel Blaster version of the MP5SD is a beautiful rendition in 1 to 1 scale of a model specifically developed to meet the requirements of many Special Operations Forces around the world!

The MP5 is a submachine gun, developed by a German manufacturer in the 1960s. A typical MP5 fires 9mm Luger ammunition from a curved detachable box-type magazine. Charging Batteries

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed charging.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also once you start to hear the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

Â Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.Â Â

This Classic Army Gel Blaster version of the MP5SD is a beautiful rendition in 1 to 1 scale of a model specifically developed to meet the requirements of many Special Operations Forces around the world!

The MP5 is a submachine gun, developed by a German manufacturer in the 1960s. A typical MP5 fires 9mm Luger ammunition from a curved detachable box-type magazine. The MP5’s accuracy, reliability, and wide range of accessories and variants have made it the submachine gun (SMG) of choice for military and law enforcement agencies worldwide.

The Classic Army MP5SD has a metal suppressor, cocking tube and receiver. The short barrel provides good accuracy up to medium to long range.
This model is fantastic out of the box and includes a metal magazine toÂ get the job done, swiftly, efficiently and without fault.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also once you start to hear the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Â CHARGING BATTERIES

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed charging.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also once you start to hear the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

Â Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

products.short_description: Aztech Innovations Perfect Pinion is a premium gel blaster gear listing with clearer tactical detail, fast Australia-wide dispatch and a more confident buying path. Secure current stock while availability remains live.
products.description:
Aztech Innovations have done it again! Designing this pinion from the ground up to improve it in every way. The tooth design is designed to make it as efficient, super strong and quiet as possible. The increase diameter of the shaft enables it to use a much larger M3 size grub screw meaning you will be able to make sure it is tightened harder on the motor shaft and not strip those tiny allen keys all the time. It also means there is more contact area for loctite to hold. The grub screw will be the torx type meaning extra ability for tightening and come with the torx key to suit.

The bevelled area on the larger shaft also means that for assembly, you adjust the motor up all the way till the bevel hits the bevel gear (while not running) then back it off one turn for the perfect alignment.

Made of SCM440, then quenched, tempered and then nitride treatment means this pinion is the strongest pinion on the market bar none!

products.name: Aztech HARDENED Hybrid Anti-Reverse latch
products.short_description: Aztech HARDENED Hybrid Anti-Reverse latch is a premium gel blaster gear listing with clearer tactical detail, fast Australia-wide dispatch and a more confident buying path. Check availability and move when the timing suits your build.
products.description:
Elevate the reliability of your gearbox with Aztech Innovations’ pioneering Hybrid Anti-Reverse Latch. The Achilles’ heel of traditional anti-reverse latches is the spring – a conventional torsion spring that, despite its critical role, is doomed to fail over time due to stress and wear.

Aztech Innovations has revolutionized this component by integrating a traditional compression coil spring, renowned for its significantly longer lifespan and enhanced spring rate. This innovation ensures an improved locking mechanism, setting a new benchmark in gearbox performance.

Crafted through precision CNC milling from SS440 steel and subsequently hardened, this hybrid latch is built to last. Its design features a custom compression spring securely bonded into the latch’s rear, ensuring unparalleled durability and function.

The latch boasts a wider contact surface, providing increased engagement with the bevel gear’s lock surface. This enhancement not only improves longevity but also bolsters reliability, ensuring your gearbox operates smoothly under any condition. Installation is a breeze, thanks to a flat head cut on the pin, allowing for straightforward installation with just a flat head screwdriver.

Please note, however, that the Hybrid Anti-Reverse Latch is not compatible with Retro Arms gearboxes due to a mismatch in the pole size required for the spring seating.

With Aztech Innovations’ Hybrid Anti-Reverse Latch, you’re not just replacing a part; you’re upgrading to a new era of gearbox reliability and performance.

products.description:
Introducing the Accu-Port Piston Head from Aztech Innovations, a game-changer in airsoft precision and performance. This adjustable piston head is designed to enhance your airsoft gun’s accuracy and minimize grouping spread through its innovative port adjustment feature.

This unique system functions like a tunable cylinder port, releasing pressure to allow for infinite adjustment levels. Tailor your setup to achieve unparalleled accuracy by fine-tuning the piston head to perfectly complement your barrel, ideal for correcting over volumed or improperly ported cylinders.Crafted from high-quality CNC 7075 Aluminium, the Accu-Port Piston Head is built for durability and performance.

It comes equipped with a thrust bearing and a pre-fitted silicone rubber O-ring, plus an additional upgrade Viton O-ring for superior resilience and sealing. The piston head’s anodized finish not only adds to its aesthetic appeal but also enhances its corrosion resistance.The design incorporates the possibility to add Angle of Engagement (AOE) spacers between the piston body and head, allowing for further customization. Additionally, the slotted internal base ensures ease of piston assembly, making installation a breeze.

Designed to maximize FPS and overall performance, the Accu-Port Piston Head sets a new standard in the Aztech piston head lineup. It is compatible with Airsoft V2 and V3 gearboxes. For optimal tuning and the correct length in Aztech or APS gearboxes, we recommend pairing it with the Aztech Spring retainer, ensuring it does not intrude more than 40mm.Elevate your airsoft game with the Accu-Port Piston Head by Aztech Innovations, where precision engineering meets unmatched performance.

  2. From new the port will be adjusted to the closed /off position which will not allow any air through.

  4. Best performance is most likely to be within the range of 3-5 full turns from the off position.

products.name: Armoury Factory Re-Tuning
products.short_description: Armoury Factory Re-Tuning is a premium gel blaster gear listing with clearer tactical detail, fast Australia-wide dispatch and a more confident buying path. Secure current stock while availability remains live.
products.description:
Â For maximum reliability every AEG gearbox should be tuned.

Unfortunately factory assembly staff are not able to perfectly tune gears for correct alignment and meshing, pistons are not set to the correct angle of engagement (AOE) with the gear.

This includes:

-Gearbox Radius
-Gears re-shimmed
-Gears correctly greased
-Sorbo pad add to cylinder head
-Angle of engagement corrected
-Viton O ring installed and lubricated
-Motor Height adjusted and loctited

Please note there is 3 different options to choose from, APS V2, CYMA V2 and APS V3.Â 

All parts used are the same, but variances occur which means some are better than other from the factory.Â 

This service pays for our technicians to open the gearbox, re shim the gears, add a sorbo pad and correct AOE of the piston, plus we will radius the front internal corners of the cylinder housing to great extend the life span of the cast metal gearbox.Â 

Radius cutsÂ are a vital part of any cast metal gearbox build.Â  Rounding off a sharp 90 degree inner apex of a corner removes the fracture point that is a vital part of engineering design and massively reduces the chance of cracking.

This service does not cover a comprehensive gearbox build that may take a few hours to complete.Â  This is a tune up of factory parts for massively improving reliability from standard.Â 

If you would like further parts installed please contact us prior to 11am to ensure work is complete

This service will add up 3 days to the picking and packing of your order as our technicians will need to complete the work prior to shipping.

PLEASE NOTE: this service means our technicians have opened the receiver and taken it apart.Â  As a result you may find the take down pins, nuts bolts and screws may have some paint worn off, wear or marksÂ showing on or around the receiver from handling and being worked on as a result of using tools to work on the blaster.Â  While we take every care we can to try and keep the blaster in as new condition, marks are inevitable when opening a blaster.

products.description:
Â 

Description

APS Phantom Extremis MKI SDU Gel Blaster- Black

Say hello to the Phantom Extremis MK1 Gel Blaster with SDU.Â 

The MK1 build is based on popular American carbine styles and equipped with the ever popular modular M-LokÂ handguard.

A long,Â topÂ RIS 22 mm railÂ allows for the attachment of various optical sights.

The set includes a kit ofÂ flip-up iron sights.

The MK1 is ambidextrous which is great for right and left hand play. Furthermore, the MK1 features a proprietary APS Phantom Overload pistol grip with exchangeable, anti-slip EVA panels that also features a system of absorbing the shock generated by the motor, thus improving its efficiency.

The receiver and handguard designÂ provides the MK1 with a modern and aggressive appearance.Â The handguard was made in M-LokÂ system, which allows for the customization of the positioning of rails according to UserÂ preferences. The gel blaster also features a custom, enlarged charging handle.

The MK1 has a fixed stock with a room for a battery. The access to the storage compartment is gained after the removal of the stock pad.Â 

The heart of the Phantom MK1 consists of aÂ eSilveredge SDU Gearbox. A unique technology has been used during the production process of this gearbox in order to assure the most accurate polish and finish of its elements.Â  The gel blaster is equipped with a Quick Spring Change System that allows the User to change the spring without having to open up the gearbox. The MK1 is hitting around 280+ FPS of Hardened Gel Balls.Â 

The Phantom Extremis MK1 has many amazing features and simply looks stunning!Â 

Features

eSilver Edge Gearbox

Quick Change Spring System
The Quick Change Spring Guide has 4 locking legs instead of 2.
Polished and Buffed housing surface.
8mm Bearing Bushings, Bearing Piston Head and Bearing Spring Guide.
Mosfet Installed

  • New Stylish Flash Hider (ICEFYRE Muzzle Break)
  • Slim and light weight KeyMod Hand Guard with Hand Stop implicit in the design, which gives your support hand a low profile anchor point in the forend.Â – (Phantom Dash 10 “)
  • New Phantom Low Profile Back Up Sight LP BUSÂ 
  • The new pistol grip (phantom overload) that pre-installed with non-slip EVA plastic at the front and rear increases the comfort of holding it.
  • New version of Magazine Ambi Catch on both sides (Phantom Ambi Mags Release)
  • New Ambi trigger selector on both sides (Phantom Long / Short Throw safety selector)
  • New Ambi loading handle (Combat Ambi phantom load identifier)
  • Flat Trigger (Enhance Control and lighter perceived weight)
  • RS-1 stock installed (R Series 1 stock)

**Orange tip shown for illustration purposes**

Specs

  • Gel Type: 7-8mm
  • Inner barrel size: 7.5mm
  • Barrel Type: Polished Stainless Steel
  • Battery Source: 7.4 Li Po Battery with Mini Tamiya
  • Alloy SilverÂ Edge Gear Box Installed

  • M100 Spring
  • 480 Long Shaft Motor
  • Velocity: 280+FPS
  • Fire Selector: Safe / Semi Auto / Full Auto
  • Metal Hand GuardÂ andÂ ABSÂ Gen 8Â MagazineÂ 
  • Metal Gear Box, Receiver, Sliding Stock, Handguard, Outer Barrel.
  • Pistol Grip is made of a reinforced polymer.Â 
  • Magazine Capacity: 250 Gels
  • Suitable Hopup: DK-Gen 10 Reverse Thread HopupÂ 
  • Recommended Gels – Ultra Hard

** Battery, Charger & Gels not included

ESILVEREDGE GEARBOX SDU INSTRUCTIONS/SPEC

SDU2.0 is a programmable ECU chips that is being used in eSilver Edge Gear Box

Simply pressing down the button underneath the gear box, user can switch its fire selector modes (total 5 different modes). No external device or trigger control are needed, it is easy to program anytime and anywhere by the user.

First, connect your AEG with a fully charged battery (7.4V) Battery. The usual battery that you used when you play.

Second, find the switch button. The button is located underneath the gear box reachable from the magwell of the lower receiver.

How to change the mode?

Step 1) Press and hold the button. You will see a Red LED light on, hold till you see its blinking 2 times, release the button to accept the changes. Repeat Step 1 to continue your choice.

**Double click the button or unplug the battery anytime to reset the ECU back to its factory settings (Mode 1) **

Use of Advanced S.D.U.â„¢ chips

The S.D.U.â„¢ chipset that is used in the eSilver Edge Gear Box has a unique function that stops the gearbox from further damage if the electric current is too high. Simply to say, electric current / Ampere will increase if there is a malfunction inside the gearbox. For instant, bad motor, damaged gears or short circuit. When our S.D.U. detects more than 5 trigger presses in exceed Amps, the whole gearbox will shut down to prevent further damage. User has to disconnect and then reconnect the power supply to reboot the gearbox, we strongly recommended the user to check the internals immediately if mal-function happens.

Micro Switch Trigger

The eSilver Edge Gear Box standard comes with a micro switch trigger which works together with the S.D.U.â„¢,Â  providing you an instant trigger response when shooting. Base on our testing, the response time of the switch is just 0.02 sec and designed for two hundred thousand presses. With the short stroke design of the trigger, it is unbelievably fast and you wonâ€™t feel any trigger delay when shooting.

products.description:
Built to perform!!Â  Undoubtedly our best selling blaster and so manys favorite!!

The little MPX is truly a top performer.Â 
Small packaging perfect for CQB and Speedball games but with the Gen 8 magazine capability of up to 250 gels.
The sporty skeletonized receiver keeps weight down, while the short M-Lok forend is accessories ready and the super comfy collapsible CRS arm brace style buttstock retracts to make a tiny tiny package.
The battery housing looksÂ tinyÂ but can hold up to our 1200mah 7.4 and 11.1vÂ  lipo battery with ease giving great battery capacity for the enthusiastic player.

NowÂ comes with SDU2.0 Programmable Gear Box

Please note that all of the Black Multicam patterns will vary a littleÂ 

  • Specification as follow:
      • eSilveredge Gearbox (SDU 2.0) ECU Chips
      • Micro Trigger Switch for instant trigger response
      • Built in MOSFET on the SDU2.0 Chips to cut the power when Amp is too high.
    • Competition style aluminum receiver w/ lightening cuts
    • M-LOK compatible hand guard allows for easy addition of accessories or rail space
    • 3 position CRS Butt Stock
    • Ambidextrous fire controls and magazine release
    • Unique duck bill style muzzle device
    • Ergonomic motor grip
    • Powered by the eSilverEdge gearbox with quick change spring system
    • Caliber: 7mmÂ gels
    • Inner barrel size: 7.5mm
    • Energy Source: 7.4v Small Type LiPo recommended (Wired to stock with small Tamiya connector, battery not included)
    • SilverÂ Gear Box Installed
    • 8mm Metal Bearings
    • Velocity: ~270 FPS
    • Plastic Hand Grip, Butt Stock and MagazineÂ 
    • Metal Body, Gear Box and Hand Guard
    • Rate of Fire: 750 ~ 850 Rounds Per minute
    • Magazine Capacity :Â 250 gels

    Use of e-Silver Edge Gear Box SDU2.0 (Ambidextrous design)

    APS SDU2.0 Electronic Gear Box, A Super Dynamic Micro Chip Unit that works together with magnet gears set, reinforced piston, quick change spring guide and micro switch trigger that gives you instant trigger response when shooting.Â  The circuit board of the micro-chip is replaceable and programmable. Repairing is easy and friendly. Simply pressing down the button underneath of the gear box, user can switch its fire selector modes (total 5 different modes). No external device or trigger control are needs, it is easy to program anytime and anywhere by the user.

    Pre-Programmed Firing Modes:Â 

  • Mode 1 – Safe / Semi / Auto
  • Mode 2 – Safe / Semi / 3rd Burst
  • Mode 3 – Safe / 2rd Burst / Auto
  • Mode 4 – Safe / 3rd Burst / Auto
  • Mode 5 – Safe / 3rd Burst / 9rd Burst

        • How to change the mode?

          Step 1) Press and hold the button. You will see a Red LED light on, hold till you see its blinking 2 times, release the button to accept the changes. Repeat Step 1 to continue your choice.

          Choice of Firing Mode:

          Mode 1 (Default)

          Safe

          Semi

          Nine Burst


          **Double click the button or unplug the battery anytime to reset the ECU back to its factory settings (Mode 1)

These will give you outstanding distance and accuracy andÂ are proven to work well over 300fps, we have tested these to over 400fps with amazing results.

These are usable in some CO2 and green gas pistols. But may not be hard enough for pistols that are harsh on gels.

products.description:
Features

  • Full size replica of the trusted M1 Garand battle rifle w/ beautifully stained real wood furniture
  • Metal receiver and barrel assembly
  • Adjustable rear sight
  • Front and rear sling rings; Stacking swivel
  • Version 7 gearbox
  • Functioning trigger guard safety
  • Drop free magazine feeds from the bottom of the rifle; Low profile magazine release on the left side of the receiver maintains traditional M1 styling

The first standard issue semi-automatic rifle issued to the US Armed Forces, the M1 Garand was referred to as “the greatest battle implement ever devised” by General George S. Patton. Replacing the venerable Springfield M1903 in 1936, the M1 Garand quickly displayed its huge advantage on the battlefield. During World War II, the M1 Garand saw extensive use and gave US forces a major advantage in firefights against Axis soldiers who were usually issued slower bolt-action rifles. The M1 Garand remained in service throughout the Korean War and even had limited deployment in the early years of the Vietnam War. The rifle still continues to be used even in the modern day by drill teams and military honor guards as well as in the civilian market long after it was retired from active service.

A&K has faithfully reproduced the venerable M1 Garand in an AEG that everyone can afford. Striving to offer the most realism and reliability for your dollar, the A&K M1 Garand features a stained wood stock and a metal alloy receiver and barrel assembly giving this M1 a realistic look and feel that will have you believing you are pushing through the hedgerows in the south of France. Internally the A&K M1 Garand is powered by a version 7 gearbox allowing a level of customization and upgradeability not found in other M1 AEG replicas on the market. While all the major features of a good M1 Garand replica are there, A&K did not skimp on the details including a period correct safety, bayonet lug, sling rings stacking swivel and an authentic sight picture. Whether you are a WWII re-enactor or an gel blaster player looking to field a unique rifle, the A&K M1 Garand delivers on looks, performance, realism and usability that puts it at the front of the pack.

products.description:
The MK46 is a variant of the base M249 or Minimi seen and used by many militaries around the world. The MK46 in particular is a variant used by the United States military forces and can easily be differentiated from the baseline M249. The two key differences are the addition of Picatinny rails on the upper receiver for the mounting of optics and the railed handguard up front.

This MK46 replica is T8’s attempt to modernize the aging A&K MK46 machine gun gel blaster. Externally, other than the nice and authentic battle-worn finish, this machine gun gel blaster carries all the nice bits from the original A&K MK46, featuring a quick detach barrel and adjustable rear sights with Picatinny railed top cover, and handguard for accessories. The lower receiver has been updated to be of CNC construction and the buffer tube is of M4 / AR15 spec with a stock that is made for M4 / AR 15 giving it arguably better ergonomics.

Internally, this machine gun has an updated gearbox with a high-torque motor and CNC gear set, 8mm bearings, a piston with steel teeth, and also a quick detachable spring system allowing for quick spring change for different FPS, allowing users to tune thisÂ  machine gun gel blaster to your favorite field’s requirements with ease.
